name: SYNTHETIC fixture shaped like an OpenRouter usage export (not real data)
license_note: The fixture itself is synthetic and written for this repository. Real OpenRouter rankings data is CC BY 4.0 according to the project's research notes (openrouter.ai/data); fetching it needs an OpenRouter API key and a check of the current terms. Neither was done here.
how_to_fetch_real_data: 1) A person creates an OpenRouter API key (never commit it). 2) Confirm the rankings/usage export endpoint, its fields and license on openrouter.ai/data. 3) Save the export locally and convert it to {period, rows:[{model, tokens}]}. 4) PYTHONPATH=server python3 -m modelreceipts_server import-seed openrouter --input export.json
